objects.name: title
objects.description: One work the library holds or wants: the bibliographic record, not a physical copy.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Stable URL key for this title. Fixed at creation — the private notes and share links hang off it.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The title's human-readable title, shown on its card.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One-paragraph description for the card, so a listing never parses the document.

fields.name: doc
fields.description: The whole bibliographic record — contributors, subjects, identifiers, edition. Queried in place by path rather than parsed per row.

fields.name: visibility
fields.description: Who may read the document: nothing outside review sees a pending one, and a private one needs a live share key.

fields.name: submitted_by
fields.description: What wrote this revision — a run, or a person.

fields.name: approved_at
fields.description: When it last left pending. Cleared whenever the document changes, because the reviewed thing no longer exists.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the row was last written.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Soft delete. A deleted row is invisible to every read.

indexes.name: visibility
indexes.description: Separates catalogued titles from those still being processed.

indexes.name: isbn
indexes.description: Finds a title by ISBN, and stops the same edition being catalogued twice.

objects.name: acquisition_note
objects.description: What the acquisitions desk knows about a title and no borrower may see.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: The title these notes belong to. One row per title.

fields.name: readme
fields.description: The selector's note on why the library holds this.

fields.name: sales
fields.description: Supplier terms and standing orders, as Markdown.

fields.name: module_configs
fields.description: Per-module configuration for this entry, keyed by module code. Never leaves the operator surface.

fields.name: appeal
fields.description: One line saying why this ranks where it does.

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Position in the running order, lowest first. Zero means unranked and sorts last.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When these notes were last written.

objects.name: preview_link
objects.description: One key that opens a title that is not yet public — a proof, or an embargoed record.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: The title this key opens.

fields.name: key_hash
fields.description: SHA-256 of the raw key, hex-encoded. The raw key is returned once at issue and never stored.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Optional note about who this link went to.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether the key still opens its entry. Retired links are kept rather than deleted, so a rotation leaves a trail.

fields.name: created_by
fields.description: Who issued it.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was issued.

fields.name: retired_at
fields.description: When it stopped working. Empty while active.

indexes.name: slug_status
indexes.description: Finds the live keys for one title.

objects.name: purchase_request
objects.description: A patron's request that the library buy something, waiting on a selector before anything is ordered.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: The slug the title would take. Checked against the catalogue first, so a title already held is never requested twice.

fields.name: title
fields.description: What the patron asked for.

fields.name: why
fields.description: Why the patron wants it, and who else would use it.

fields.name: source
fields.description: What filed it.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Where it has got to. Only fulfilling it may set 'built'; the tenth failed attempt stalls it.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Queue position, lowest first. The gap either side leaves room to reorder without renumbering.

fields.name: attempts
fields.description: How many builds have failed. Cleared when an approval sends a stalled row back for another ten.

fields.name: proposal
fields.description: What is known about the wanted item — author, edition, supplier. Anything domain-shaped, such as a genre, lives here.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: The run that filed it.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was filed.

fields.name: decided_at
fields.description: When it was approved or rejected. Empty while proposed.

indexes.name: status_priority
indexes.description: The selector's queue: approved requests, best priority first.

objects.name: request_note
objects.description: One note on a purchase request, usually the selector saying why they decided as they did.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: suggestion_id
fields.description: The proposal this note is about.

fields.name: author
fields.description: Which side wrote it.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: The run that wrote it, when a run did.

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: Which build attempt this came out of. Zero for a note that is not about an attempt.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The note itself — the reason a patron is owed.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was written.

indexes.name: suggestion_created
indexes.description: Reads one request's notes in order.

objects.name: request_fulfilment
objects.description: Records that one title answers one purchase request.

fields.name: suggestion_id
fields.description: The request that was met.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: The title that meets it.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: The run that built it.

fields.name: note
fields.description: What the run said about the match.

fields.name: met_at
fields.description: When the match was recorded.

indexes.name: slug
indexes.description: Finds the requests one title answered.

objects.name: import_run
objects.description: One MARC import run, and its own report of what it loaded.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: The run's own identifier, as the routine knows it.

fields.name: submitted_by
fields.description: What reported it.

fields.name: templates_filed
fields.description: How many titles the import wrote.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: The import's own report of what it did.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was recorded.

objects.name: setting
objects.description: One run-time knob the catalogue reads, such as the loan period or the default shelving scheme.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The setting's name.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Its current value.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When it was last written.

objects.name: page_view
objects.description: A running count for one catalogue page.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Which kind of page was viewed: the front page, or one title's.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: The title viewed. Empty for the front page.

fields.name: views
fields.description: Running total. There are no per-day rows, so nothing here answers a question about a trend.

objects.name: copy
objects.description: One physical copy of a title on a shelf. The library's own object — the catalog module has no rule that touches it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: The title this is a copy of.

fields.name: shelfmark
fields.description: Where it sits, and the barcode staff scan. Unique across the library.

fields.name: condition
fields.description: Whether it can still be lent.

fields.name: acquired_at
fields.description: When it entered stock.

indexes.name: slug_condition
indexes.description: Counts the lendable copies of one title.
